source: jj-xet 01b6173, tests/openxet.rs (its mock of openxet) and src/remote.rs (what the client reads), transcribed 2026-10-25 (ADR 0005). The mock's message texts and its relative download href are mock details no jj-xet test depends on: the client prints `message (hint: hint)` from any error body and never fetches the download href (ADR 0003, jj-xet compatibility). Format: `{name}` strings are placeholders the replayer fills (`{oid}`, `{size}`, `{unknown_oid}`, `{xet_hash}`); `<string>`, `<int>`, `<future-epoch>` and `<http-url>` match any value of that kind; `json` keys are dotted paths, numbers indexing lists. Replayed by `jj_xet_mock_expectations` in crates/hub/tests/lfs.rs.

cases.name: refresh repeats the same request (Refresher; short_lived_tokens_are_refreshed)
rejected token is a 401 the client reports to its credential helper (rejected_token_fails_snapshot_instead_of_committing_contents)
no credential is a 401 (the client asks git's credential helpers)
download batch of a registered object carries X-Xet-Hash (lookup_xet_hash)
download batch of an unknown object is an object error 404 (wrong_hashes_from_the_server_are_not_cached)
